posts.text: Loose lips can sink a great ship.  Protect who has influence over your and your inner circle.

Hey @jimmykimmel, what is funny about this?

Joking is one thing, but wishing death on the President by telling Melania “Mrs. Trump, you have a glow like an expectant widow”? 

That’s not comedy, that’s dangerous rhetoric.

We’re better than this.

Video
Good times last night at the Daddy daughter dance. 🕺🏾 💃

The devil is in the details.👇🏽


Chamath Palihapitiya (@chamath)

On page twenty-six of “The Billionaire Tax” proposal in California, it explains how the state legislature can convert from a Billionaire Tax to an Everyone Tax without voter approval. 

They can also adjust the tax to be a yearly tax, not just one time…again, without your approval. 

Intelligence test for you: if this was meant to just target Billionaires, why did they write this in?



— https://nitter.net/chamath/status/20481356

No U.S. media company should EVER be allowed to sell majority control to China.

A Chinese investor owns 51% of Forbes since 2014. 

Forbes, an American media icon, now answering to foreign interests.

From celebrating capitalists to attacking the very people who built 🇺🇸.


Forbes (@Forbes)

Elon Musk is the planet’s richest person by far, worth $839 billion as of Forbes’ annual World’s Billionaires list. He also ranks among the least philanthropic billionaires. 

Sure, Musk has transferred $8.

You need help.


Mary L Trump (@MaryLTrump)

So weird Donald didn't stand up, ask for his shoes, defiantly raise his fist, and say "Fight, fight, fight."



— https://nitter.net/MaryLTrump/status/2048209143278776358#m

I have two thoughts:

1.  How the hell did the shooter get in WHCD?

2.  What needs to happen to those who keep inciting violence?  

There needs to be some accountability taken before it's too late.  

The indictment of SPLC is a good start but we got work to do.

Constant surveillance?   

An absolute Terrible idea.


Pubity (@pubity)

Every new car in the U.S. will be required by law to have tech that puts constant surveillance on the driver by 2027.

AI in your car will determine if you're sober and fit to drive, automatically turning off the vehicle if it determines you're a danger on the road.







— https://nitter.net/pubity/status/2047994026029433116#m

Atrophy is the wasting away of a muscle, tissue, or organ due to lack of usage. 

This applies to our brain as much as it does to our physical body. 

Learn on your own creativity first before jumping on ChatGPT or perplexity. 

Don’t let your most important muscle 🧠 atrophy.

Video

Great leaders don’t avoid conflicts, they manage it.

Conflict is inevitable. In life, in business and in the arena you compete in.  

Choose and learn to confront respectfully.

Today is Armenian Genocide Remembrance Day.

We remember 1.5M Armenians, 500K Greeks & 300K Assyrians murdered by the Ottoman Empire.

A tragedy meant to erase a people that failed.

It didn’t break them, instead it forged them.

Today, their descendants lead, build, and rise across the world. 

Future looks bright!

You know you live in the greatest country in the world, when the loudest critics still choose to stay.

There’s no place like 🇺🇸. 

However, it’ll take every ounce of fight by the next generation to keep it great.

Leaders don’t just create followers, but they create  leaders.

If others replicate what you do. day in and day out, would they win?

Great news.

Eight Iranian women protesters who were scheduled to be executed tonight will now be spared.

Think about that for a moment, 
a world where a U.S. president has to ask another country (IRGC) to show mercy to eight women.

Respect to the President.


The White House (@WhiteHouse)

“Very good news! I have just been informed that eight women protestors who were going to be executed tonight in Iran will no longer be killed…” - President Donald J. Trump 🇺🇸





— https://nitter.net/White

You either control your imagination or your imagination controls you.

If you let it loose, it can cause constant stress and anxiety.

The great @ArmanUfc.  

Not only a great fighter but “low key” a strong backgammon player.

Future looks bright!

Future leader of Poland.   👇🏽


Dominik Tarczyński MEP (@D_Tarczynski)

Almost two hours on one of America’s biggest shows!

We covered mass migration, “refugees” raping goats and sheep in Europe, Qatargate, President Trump, but most of all, about my beautiful Poland! 

Thank you @patrickbetdavid and I look forward to hosting you in Warsaw! 🇵🇱🇺🇸





— https://nitter.net/D_Tarczynski/status/2046611439696130071#m
Confidence comes from keeping promises to yourself.
